```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(dcg/basics)).

main :-
    read_all(Input),
    parse(Input, N, C, Coords0),
    (   N == 0 -> true
    ;   msort(Coords0, Coords),
        nth0(0, Coords, First),
        last(Coords, Last),
        Hi0 is Last - First,
        binary_search(1, Hi0, Coords, C, 0, Ans),
        format("~d~n", [Ans])
    ).

binary_search(Lo, Hi, _, _, Ans, Ans) :- Lo > Hi, !.
binary_search(Lo, Hi, Coords, C, _, Ans) :-
    Lo =< Hi,
    Mid is Lo + (Hi - Lo) // 2,
    count_placed(Coords, Mid, Count),
    (   Count >= C
    ->  NewLo is Mid + 1,
        binary_search(NewLo, Hi, Coords, C, Mid, Ans)
    ;   NewHi is Mid - 1,
        binary_search(Lo, NewHi, Coords, C, _, Ans)
    ).

count_placed([X|Xs], Mid, Count) :-
    count_loop(Xs, X, Mid, 1, Count).

count_loop([], _, _, Count, Count) :- !.
count_loop([X|Xs], Prev, Mid, Acc, Count) :-
    (   X - Prev >= Mid
    ->  Acc1 is Acc + 1,
        count_loop(Xs, X, Mid, Acc1, Count)
    ;   count_loop(Xs, Prev, Mid, Acc, Count)
    ).

read_all(S) :-
    current_input(In),
    read_string(In, _, S).

parse(Input, N, C, Coords) :-
    number(N, Rest0, Input),
    whites(Rest0, Rest1),
    number(C, Rest2, Rest1),
    whites(Rest2, Rest3),
    numbers(Rest3, Coords).

numbers(S, Ns) :- (   S == [] -> Ns = []
    ;   number(_, Rest, S) -> whites(Rest, Rest2), numbers(Rest2, Ns2), Ns = Ns2
    ;   Ns = []
    ).
```

    ;   NewHi is Mid - 1,

    ).

    ;   count_loop(Xs, Prev, Mid, Acc, Count)
    ).

read_all(S) :-
    current_input(In),
    read_string(In, _, S).

parse(Input, N, C, Coords) :-
    parse_nums(Input, [N, C | Coords]).

parse_nums(S, Ns) :-
    (   S == [] -> Ns = []
    ;   parse_num(S, N, Rest)
    ->  Ns = [N | Ns2],
        parse_nums(Rest, Ns2)
    ;   Ns = []
    ).

parse_num(S, N, Rest) :-
    skip_nonnum(S, S1),
    S1 \== [],
    digits_value(S1, 0, N, Rest).

skip_nonnum([H|T], R) :-
    (   H >= 48, H =< 57 -> R = [H|T]
    ;   skip_nonnum(T, R)
    ).
skip_nonnum([], []).

digits_value([H|T], Acc, N, Rest) :-
    H >= 48, H =< 57,
    !,
    Acc1 is Acc * 10 + (H - 48),
    digits_value(T, Acc1, N, Rest).
digits_value(S, Acc, Acc, S).
